description: Machine-readable contract for generating a third-party audit handoff bundle as Markdown and JSON without omitting pending external validations.

pendingExternalValidationPolicy.source: tracked files via git grep plus untracked non-ignored first-party text files
pendingExternalValidationPolicy.coverageRule: The generated JSON must include every tracked and untracked non-ignored occurrence of the required phrase with path, line and excerpt.
pendingExternalValidationPolicy.nonOmissionGate: pendingExternalValidationCount must equal the repository occurrence count used by the generator.

privacyBoundary: Audit handoff output must not embed real tokens, secrets, DSNs, private keys, production credentials, user report bodies or non-redacted production payloads.
nonClaims: Does not prove production API live connectivity unless external live evidence is supplied.
Does not prove Telegram Bot live smoke without real operator credentials.
Does not prove OIDC, SIEM, immutable audit storage, retention cleaner, trace backend or alert live status.
Does not replace third-party audit review.
